verdict.rationale: An in-product AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of a SaaS release-management platform, but the evidence pack never documents one. The MCP server lets external AI clients such as Cursor or Claude Code manage flags in natural language, which belongs to a different story and earns no credit here. The AI pricing items describe tooling for customers' own LLM features, not an assistant users can delegate tasks to inside LaunchDarkly.
